config.scope: Controlled reimplementation on the project's exact S1/S2 split; not a claim of byte-identical original-paper training
config.noise_sigma: sigma = U(0,1)^2; matches author's quadratic-noise distribution
config.training_objective: blind Gaussian denoising; pixel mean squared noise-prediction error
config.train_selection: fresh-noise train-set validation only; other-set error is diagnostic and never selects checkpoints
config.convergence: after minimum steps: three evaluation intervals with relative range < 0.01, learning rate <= 6.25e-5, mean train validation MSE < 0.04; otherwise maximum-step runs are needs_review, not converged
config.source_seeds: 0..255, independently seeded CPU Gaussian generators, saved once and shared exactly
config.sampler: shared VE Heun schedule, rho=7; output is each method's own clean-data readout at the final state
config.empirical_definition: exact sigma-conditional empirical denoiser; this differs from the sigma-marginal blind-training Bayes estimator
config.metric: centered cosine for both paired outputs and closest original references; fixed [0,1] clipping with clipping fraction retained
deviations_from_original: project split Nmax=98023 instead of author's checkpoint Nmax=99325
batch32 and adaptive convergence schedule instead of author's batch512/epoch schedule
common explicit-sigma probability-flow ODE instead of author's residual-controlled sampling
primary MLP has 6400-wide layers and is not parameter-count matched to UNet
one paired training seed in primary sweep; training-seed replication is needed before causal architecture claims
common prior mean fixed at gray midpoint 0.5; finite-noise prior approximation is explicit
config.publication_gate: all main-N model pairs pass convergence and sampling checks; fixed galleries still require visual quality review; do not interpret a failed MLP as evidence of an intrinsic architecture limit
config.initialization: one shared y_T=0.5+sigma_max*epsilon; center is fixed intensity midpoint, not fitted on either set
